title: Morning, the chair at the end
logline: The lawn chair at the dock's end where it was moved, facing the flats, the morning sun on its webbing, and a hand on its back from behind — not sitting, standing behind it. Nine days before the last page.

panels.composition: An old lawn chair at the far end of a dock facing gold morning flats, a man's hand resting on its back from behind, the arm going out of frame, the bay bright.

characters.pose: a hand on the chair's back

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old lawn chair at the far end of a wooden dock facing gold morning tidal flats with a man's hand resting on its back from behind and the arm going out of frame, a bright bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
